seoTitle: How to Get Semrush API Access and Generate Your Key
metaDescription: Learn how to get Semrush API access, which plans include API units, and how to generate your API key for keyword, traffic, and backlink data.
intro: Pulling Semrush data programmatically opens the door to custom dashboards and automated reporting, but you need to know where API access lives and how it's billed. This guide explains which Semrush plans include API credits, how to generate your API key, and how usage limits work. It's written for developers and SEO professionals who want to move beyond the standard dashboard.

steps.heading: Confirm your plan includes API access
steps.body: Check your Semrush subscription details to see whether API credits are included, since access typically depends on your plan tier.

steps.heading: Check your available API units
steps.body: Review how many API units your plan provides, as this determines how much data you can pull before hitting limits.

steps.heading: Generate your API key
steps.body: Head to your Semrush account settings to locate and generate the API key you'll use to authenticate requests.

steps.heading: Understand how API units and limits work
steps.body: Different types of requests consume different amounts of units, so review Semrush's documentation to plan your usage efficiently.

steps.heading: Make a basic API request
steps.body: Use your API key to pull a simple dataset, like keyword or traffic data, to confirm everything is set up correctly before building out more complex integrations.

faq.question: Do all Semrush plans include API access?
faq.answer: No, API access and the number of included units typically vary by plan, so you'll want to confirm this with your specific subscription.

faq.question: What can I do with the Semrush API?
faq.answer: The API lets you pull data like keyword research, traffic analytics, and backlink analysis programmatically for use in custom dashboards or reports.

faq.question: What happens if I run out of API units?
faq.answer: Once you exhaust your available API units, you'll typically need to purchase additional units or wait for your plan's allocation to refresh.

faq.question: Is coding experience required to use the Semrush API?
faq.answer: Yes, some technical or development knowledge is needed to send API requests and work with the returned data effectively.
